title: Dadka Degan Labada Beerood
intro: Dhul ay nimcooyinku si aad ah uga qulqulayeen, bulsho mar waxay ku raaxaysan jirtay laba beerood oo qurux badan. Noloshooda waxay caddayn u ahayd nimco rabbaani ah, haddana sheekadoodu waxay isbeddeshay markii mahadnaqu libdhay, taasoo horseeday isbeddel calaamad u noqon doona dhammaan kuwa fekera.
clues: Waxaan ahayn dad ku mannaystay dhul raaxo iyo barwaaqo leh.
Rabbigeen wuxuu na siiyay laba beerood oo qurux badan, oo dhinac walba barwaaqo iyo midho leh.
Waxaa nala faray inaan mahadnaqno, laakiin waxaan doorannay gaalnimo oo waan ka jeesannay.
Biyo-xidheen weyn ayaa dib u celiyay biyaha nool ee dhulkeenna siiya.
Markii aan ku adkaysannay khaladkeenna, biyo-xidheenku wuu qarxay oo daadku wuu dhex maray.
Beeraheenna oo mar ahaa kuwo qurux badan ayaa lagu beddelay miro qadhaadh, tamarisk, iyo dhowr geed oo lote ah.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Dabaylo xooggan oo toddobo habeen ah
Roob dhagaxyo ah oo cirka ka soo da'ay
Daadad burbur ah oo ka dhashay biyo-xireen qarxay
Qaylo dheer oo cirka ka timid
trial.answer: Daadad burbur ah oo ka dhashay biyo-xireen qarxay

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Beeraheenna waxaa lagu beddelay miro qadhaadh iyo geedo yaryar
Waxaa naloo beddelay daanyeerro iyo doofaarro
Waxaa na burburiyay roob dhagaxyo ah
outcome.answer: Beeraheenna waxaa lagu beddelay miro qadhaadh iyo geedo yaryar

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
